title: First coordinate has standard Gaussian law
statement: For every $\rho\in\mathbb R$, if $(X,Y)$ has the probability distribution obtained from independent standard Gaussian variables $U,V$ by setting $X=U$ and $Y=\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,V$, then the marginal distribution of $X$ is the standard Gaussian distribution on $\mathbb R$.
